implementation_notes: A package in a monorepo (or a published package) per context. Publish one entry point via `exports` in package.json so deep imports are structurally impossible for consumers, and enforce with lint rules (import/no-internal-modules, dependency-cruiser).
idiom_name: one npm package per context + exports map + dependency rules
pitfalls: Contexts as folders in one package so deep imports remain open
Circular dependencies between contexts that nothing detects
